study.title: U.S. Residential Property Management Maintenance Communication

research_question: Is there enough verified, independent operational pain in U.S. residential property management maintenance communication to justify building a reusable software component?
decision_scope: Determine whether the verified evidence justifies progression from research into component definition. This package does not authorize software construction, investment, deployment, or commercial claims.
success_conditions: all admitted evidence is verified and traceable
no synthetic evidence or fabricated human action is present
the advisory outcome is reproducible from the same inputs and rules
the complete audit bundle verifies successfully
